Axes.Description: Table: Axes. A distinct dimension, angle, or vector along which AI's impact on education can be examined -- e.g. 'Essay Writing vs. AI-Assisted Exploration'. New axes can be added freely as the project's scope grows.

schema.name: AxisId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the axis. Slug form, e.g. 'essay-vs-ai-conversation'.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the axis.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Short human-readable title of the axis, e.g. 'Essay Writing vs. AI-Assisted Exploration'.

schema.name: Summary
schema.Description: One or two sentence summary of what this axis examines.

schema.name: Scenarios
schema.Description: Example scenarios that illustrate this axis in practice.

schema.name: Considerations
schema.Description: Individual pros and cons recorded against this axis.

schema.name: CountOfConsiderations
schema.Description: Total number of pros and cons recorded for this axis.

schema.name: CountOfPros
schema.Description: Number of pro considerations recorded for this axis.

schema.name: CountOfCons
schema.Description: Number of con considerations recorded for this axis.

Scenarios.Description: Table: Scenarios. A concrete example that illustrates how an axis plays out in practice, such as a specific classroom assignment.

schema.name: ScenarioId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the scenario. Slug form.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the scenario.

schema.name: Axis
schema.Description: The axis this scenario illustrates.

schema.name: AxisTitle
schema.Description: Title of the parent axis.

schema.name: Title
schema.Description: Short title of the scenario.

schema.name: Description
schema.Description: Full description of how the scenario plays out.

Considerations.Description: Table: Considerations. A single pro or con recorded against an axis.

schema.name: ConsiderationId
schema.Description: Stored identifier for the consideration. Slug form.

schema.name: Name
schema.Description: Display alias for the consideration.

schema.name: Axis
schema.Description: The axis this consideration belongs to.

schema.name: AxisTitle
schema.Description: Title of the parent axis.

schema.name: IsPro
schema.Description: TRUE if this consideration is a pro (benefit); FALSE if it is a con (drawback).

schema.name: Statement
schema.Description: The pro or con itself, stated in a sentence.

schema.name: Kind
schema.Description: Human-readable label for whether this is a pro or a con.
